name: DividedSplitting.theta_stdClassSum_productForm
summary: θ commutes with the class sum (it is linear, and evaluation at g is linear); apply theta_productForm to each summand and collect the class sums into cosetKernelSum.

steps.claim: (Part of the statement: it contains `let g := …`, and the line census of the checker takes that := for the declaration's, so these lines count as the value.) g_Y = g·liftMod(Y) and the summand conj(cosetKernelSum … · θ^{W, I_m}_{O.a, b'}[𝟙_{I_z}, letterPoly(−1)(η̄)](g_Y, h')).
steps.lean:
g * (liftMod Y.1).1
  conj (cosetKernelSum O b (V.stackOverGenScalar s) V.fixedEmb y g * modKernelI O.W O.a b'
    O.chosenModulusSq (Pi.single (inclMatrix _ z) 1) (letterPoly O.signs O.ord (-1) _ (star η)) g
    h') :=

steps.claim: The value is (evaluation at g ∘ O.θ) applied to the class sum; by linearity it is the class sum of the values (map_classSum), each given by theta_productForm (H, hb); expanding the products of sums and class sums (classSum_sum, mul_classSum, bilinearity) gives the definition of cosetKernelSum.
steps.lean:
show (.proj g ∘ₗ O.θ) _ = _ by simp [cosetKernelSum, map_classSum, ← classSum_sum,
  mul_classSum, ↓V.theta_productForm H hb, ← modKernelBilin_apply, mul_sum, mul_assoc]
